what_it_is: EON Space Labs is an Indian optics startup (founded 2022) engineering miniaturised electro-optical and infrared payloads for satellites, drones and ground platforms. It targets the same EO/IR niche as defence-optics players but from a space-payload integration angle.
india_angle: EON appears in India's innovation-inventory platforms (Bharat Innovates) and markets EO/IR payloads to Indian satellite builders - part of the emerging indigenous-payload supply chain reducing reliance on imported imagers.
intelligence_assessment: Catalogue and incubator evidence is verifiable; flight heritage and customer names are not yet public. Watch for payload credits on Indian satellites.

faq.a: Miniaturised EO/IR payloads for satellites, drones and ground applications.
